newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ionics Q1 net flat at 95 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ionics Q1 net flat at 95 mln pesos.

text.p: Ionics Circuits Inc posted a net income of 95 million pesos in the first three months of the year, company president Lawrence Qua told stockholders on Friday.
In the same period last year, the firm made a net income of 94.63 million pesos.
Qua said the electronics sector usually experienced low sales in the first half and it picked up in the second half of the year.
The electronics concern will be talking with U.S. firms for possible joint ventures to manufacture finished products, he said.
"We want to graduate from contract manufacturing to developing our own products," he said.
